name: Loving the Mountain Man
source:
The worst day of your life starts with losing your job and ends with your car plummeting off a cliff -- but everything changes when a sexy, bearded mountain man saves your life and takes you back to his cabin! When a snowstorm hits and traps the two of you inside, your fiery connection will be the only thing fending off the cold.

[From in-app]
translation:
人生中最糟的一天，从丢掉工作开始，以汽车坠落悬崖结束——然而，一个性感、留着胡须的山中男子救了你，将你带回自己的小屋，一切就此改变！暴风雪袭来，把你们两人困在屋内。你们之间炽热的吸引力，将成为抵御严寒的唯一依靠。

[译自应用内简介]
